_comment: Provenance for every row of published-prices-2026-09.csv, keyed by the
row's external_id, plus the prices that were found and deliberately NOT
imported, with the reason. Collected 3 September 2026 from public Libyan
pages; every price below was read verbatim from a fetched page or post.
The rule for a row to exist: the source names the town, the product, the
pack size and a date. A price whose market is unknown cannot enter a
per-town index, however good the publisher, which is why the Ministry's
daily bulletin (nashrah.ly, issue 893 of the same day) is cited below and
Licensing: none of these publishers grants reuse. A price is a fact, and
each row is attributed to its publisher by URL; the derived index is what
LICENSE-DATA licenses, not these rows. See docs/data-sources.md.

location_basis.tripoli: Almasar (اقتصاد المسار) posts each say بطرابلس or في طرابلس; Al-Araby's two articles name Tripoli; dsm.ly is the online catalogue of صيدلية ذات الصواري (Dat Essawary Pharmacy), whose physical shop is in Tripoli (Bab Al-Azizia) per directory listings — its pages print the pharmacy's name and phone but no city, so the town is the shop's, not the page's.

date_basis.dsm.ly: The catalogue shows no dates; observed_date is the day the page was fetched (2026-09-03). A catalogue price is a price offered that day.
date_basis.t.me/almasartvlibya: The post's own date. Post 62095 shows day and month (22 April) and the channel's ordering places it in 2026; the caption says 'خلال شهر أبريل الجاري'.

not_imported.reason: No Libyan page or post found that prints a price. The one pharmacy with a web catalogue (dsm.ly) returns no products for amox, augmentin, ospamox or hiconcil and has no antibiotics category; no ministry or regulator price list is published online.

dsm.ly lists four paediatric paracetamol products. The one with a stated volume, 'Paracetamol Galenica Senes 10mg/ml 100ml' at د.ل.‏ 14,000, is the intravenous infusion (10 mg/ml in a 100 ml bottle is the infusion presentation; Galenica Senese makes it), shelved under child fever relief by the shop — and the evaluation set already carries it as a labelled distractor, which is what stopped it being imported here. Adol 250mg/5ml (د.ل.‏ 19,000), Paracetamol 250mg/5ml orange (د.ل.‏ 20,000) and Calpol Six Plus (د.ل.‏ 55,000) are oral suspensions but state no bottle volume, so none can be normalised to a price per millilitre.

Two sources, neither usable per town. dsm.ly lists one sanitary towel, 'Septona sensitive normal ultra olus' at د.ل.‏ 6,250, with no pad count on the listing or the product page, so it cannot be normalised to a pack of ten. WFP's Market Price Monitoring for May 2026 prices 'Sanitary Pads (10Pc)' at 5.61 nationally and 5.42 West, 7.15 East, 4.51 South — regional averages, and a per-town index cannot place a regional mean in a town.

Priced daily by the Ministry's bulletin (nashrah.ly, issue 893 of 3 September 2026: household flour 3.25–3.75/kg, short-grain rice 6.00–6.50/kg, corn oil 12.50 and sunflower 11.50 per 850 ml) and monthly by its analytical bulletin (April 2026), but neither states a market, and the per-town index cannot use a price whose town is unknown. No Tripoli-dated retail price for these three appeared in Almasar's text posts for August–September 2026. Their newest per-town observations remain WFP's May 2026 survey, imported through the HDX file.

WFP Market Price Monitoring May 2026 gives 'Public Cooking Fuel (11Kg)' at 10.35 nationally, 3.03 West, 3.83 East, 24.29 South, without saying whether official outlets are included — regional and ambiguous, so cited and not imported.

Bottle formats found and not imported because the item is the 7 L jug: 0.5 L at 0.750 (grocers) and a دستة of twelve at 7 (Almasar via almashhadlibya.com/economic-news/134313, 18 August 2026, Tripoli); 1.5 L at 1.5 and 0.5 L at 1.0 (Al-Araby, 25 August 2026, Tripoli); 7 L at 3 with no town named (libyaalahrar.tv, 3 April 2026).

Six stage-1 listings on dsm.ly carry a price but no pack size (Aptamil Premium 1 at 40.000, Primalac 1 at 51.000, Primalac Ultima 1 at 61.000, Pediamil 1 at 39.000, Blemil Plus 1 at 42.000, Similac Total Comfort 1 at 57.000) and are not imported; stage 2 and 3 and specialty formulas are a different good.
